description: Na₆Sm₄Ge₄Se₁₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₅ square pyramids that share corners with four NaSe₅ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent GeSe₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NaSe₅ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one GeSe₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one NaSe₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.90-3.19 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₅ square pyramids that share corners with four NaSe₅ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent GeSe₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NaSe₅ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one GeSe₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one NaSe₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.90-3.14 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five Se atoms to form NaSe₅ square pyramids that share corners with four NaSe₅ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent GeSe₄ tetrahedra, edges with three NaSe₅ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one GeSe₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one NaSe₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.94-3.17 Å. There are two inequivalent Sm sites. In the first Sm site, Sm is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight Se atoms. There are a spread of Sm-Se bond distances ranging from 2.99-3.46 Å. In the second Sm site, Sm is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight Se atoms. There are a spread of Sm-Se bond distances ranging from 2.99-3.49 Å. There are two inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded to four Se atoms to form GeSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₅ square pyramids and  an edgeedge with one NaSe₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Ge-Se bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.40 Å. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded to four Se atoms to form GeSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaSe₅ square pyramids and edges with two NaSe₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Ge-Se bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.40 Å. There are nine inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to three Sm and one Ge atom to form distorted SeSm₃Ge trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent SeNa₄SmGe pentagonal pyramids, corners with six SeNa₂Sm₂Ge trigonal bipyramids, corners with four SeSm₃Ge trigonal pyramids, edges with two SeNa₂Sm₂Ge trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two SeSm₃Ge trigonal pyramids. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to three Sm and one Ge atom to form distorted SeSm₃Ge trigonal pyramids that share corners with seven SeNa₂Sm₂Ge trigonal bipyramids, corners with six SeSm₃Ge trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one SeNa₄SmGe pentagonal pyramid, edges with two SeNa₂Sm₂Ge trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one SeSm₃Ge trigonal pyramid. In the third Se site, Se is bonded to two Na, two Sm, and one Ge atom to form distorted SeNa₂Sm₂Ge trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SeNa₄SmGe pentagonal pyramid, corners with four SeNa₂Sm₂Ge trigonal bipyramids, corners with five SeSm₃Ge trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one SeNa₄SmGe pentagonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one SeNa₂Sm₂Ge trigonal bipyramid, and edges with three SeSm₃Ge trigonal pyramids. In the fourth Se site, Se is bonded to two Na, two Sm, and one Ge atom to form distorted SeNa₂Sm₂Ge trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three SeNa₂Sm₂Ge trigonal bipyramids, corners with six SeSm₃Ge trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent SeNa₄SmGe pentagonal pyramids, edges with two SeNa₂Sm₂Ge trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two SeSm₃Ge trigonal pyramids. In the fifth Se site, Se is bonded to two equivalent Na, two Sm, and one Ge atom to form distorted SeNa₂Sm₂Ge trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent SeNa₄SmGe pentagonal pyramids, corners with three SeNa₂Sm₂Ge trigonal bipyramids, corners with four SeSm₃Ge trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent SeNa₄SmGe pentagonal pyramids, edges with two SeNa₂Sm₂Ge trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two SeSm₃Ge trigonal pyramids. In the sixth Se site, Se is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Sm and one Ge atom. In the seventh Se site, Se is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Na atoms. In the eighth Se site, Se is bonded to four Na, one Sm, and one Ge atom to form distorted SeNa₄SmGe pentagonal pyramids that share corners with three SeNa₂Sm₂Ge trigonal bipyramids, corners with four SeSm₃Ge trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one SeNa₄SmGe pentagonal pyramid, edges with five SeNa₂Sm₂Ge trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one SeSm₃Ge trigonal pyramid. In the ninth Se site, Se is bonded to two Na, one Sm, and one Ge atom to form distorted SeNa₂SmGe trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent SeNa₄SmGe pentagonal pyramids, corners with two SeNa₂Sm₂Ge trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent SeSm₃Ge trigonal pyramids, edges with three SeNa₂Sm₂Ge trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one SeSm₃Ge trigonal pyramid.
